intent: Add up the read counts of each gene over the two sequencing lanes (lane1_counts.tsv and lane2_counts.tsv, columns: gene, count) to get one total per gene.
silent_error: bedtools groupby only collapses consecutive lines with the same key; its usage text states '(1) The input file/stream should be sorted/grouped by the -grp. columns'. The two lane tables concatenated are not grouped by gene, so each gene appears twice and groupby prints 12 lines, one per original line, each with its single-lane count. No error and no warning, exit 0; the table has the right columns and the numbers look like counts.

files.lane1_counts.tsv:
TP53	41
BRCA1	17
EGFR	233
MYC	95
KRAS	60
PTEN	8
files.lane2_counts.tsv:
TP53	38
BRCA1	22
EGFR	251
MYC	87
KRAS	71
PTEN	12

faulted: cat lane1_counts.tsv lane2_counts.tsv | bedtools groupby -g 1 -c 2 -o sum > gene_totals.tsv
clean: cat lane1_counts.tsv lane2_counts.tsv | sort -k1,1 | bedtools groupby -g 1 -c 2 -o sum > gene_totals.tsv
